description: Sets how many charges stand from today on for a recurring commitment, named by id or the exact name as the memory holds it — a miss answers with the real names — 240 at most. More are written a cycle apart after the last row, at the commitment's price; unpaid planned rows past the count are unwritten; paid rows, hand-set rows and the past stay. A one-time commitment has its one charge and is refused. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Proposals screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

count.description: How many charges stand from today on. 240 at most.
